measurementLimits: five sequential List samples and three member-write samples; not a production capacity benchmark
first-call connection/statement setup included; medians of these finite samples
List scale fixture: all apps owned by current non-Bootstrap actor; independent authorization tests exercise enabled-member group predicates
actual grant registry has one application workspace resource per app; 1000 submitted duplicate tuples normalize to one persistent grant

theory.List: two fixed data statements; SQL filters before transfer; O(R) returned application memory, DB join/filter and ORDER BY plan depends on A, membership/grant cardinalities and indexes
theory.members: 19 fixed data statements for a successful replacement; O(M + U log U) normalization, O(M + U) request/normalized memory; set existence/delete/insert operate on U unique submitted and existing members
theory.grants: 20 fixed data statements for successful replacement, one zipped complete-tuple validation; O(G + V log V) normalization and O(G + V) request/normalized memory; V<=1 for valid unique B5a grants
theory.notation: A stored applications, R authorized returned applications, M/G submitted members/grants, U/V unique normalized entries. Fixed round-trip count does not mean constant database work.
